plug_writes_directory: Makes the directory {path}, where one of its services keeps its configuration.
plug_writes_document: Writes {path}, the container lemonfiber derives for it.
plug_writes_region: Writes a marked region into {path}: its route through the proxy, or its dashboard entry.
plug_writes_other: Changes {path} in a way this page has no word for.
plug_contests: Leaves {capability}, which {by} asks for, claimed by {claimants} with nothing chosen between them.
plug_reached_household: {service} is reached by the household at {hostname}, on port {port}.
plug_reached_loopback: {service} is reached from this machine only, on port {port}.
plug_reached_none: {service} has nothing listening, so nothing reaches it.
plug_reaches_nothing: No recipe of it can reach anywhere outside the stack and its own services.
plug_reaches: Its recipes can reach these places outside the stack: {destinations}.
plug_proof_unproven: Proof {proof} could not be run, so it established nothing: {why}
plug_proof_declared: Proof {proof} fails only on the recordings its manifest says it fails on ({count}), and holds on the rest.
plug_proof_other: What proof {proof} came to is something this page has no word for.
plug_proofs_none: It declares no proof to hold before it counts as installed.
plug_against_recordings: Its proofs were asked of the recordings it ships, not of a running service.
plug_against_service: Its proofs were asked of the service itself, running on this machine.
plug_verified_after: Once it is in place the stack runs its own checks, and a check it makes worse puts the install back.
plug_unsettled: Nothing could be concluded about this check: {title}
plug_verified_clean: The stack's own checks read as they did before.
plug_step_outside: {method} {path} on {to}, outside the stack, which no adapter of lemonfiber's speaks to.
plug_release: Releases {value} away from where it was read: {release}
plug_reviewed: Somebody reviewed it before it was offered.
plug_reviewed_not: Nobody reviewed it before it was offered.
plug_update: Replaces {plugin} {from} with {to}, as one change that goes back whole if it does not hold.
plug_leaves: Leaves {capability} with nothing filling it; {plugin} fills it now.
plug_recipe_failed: Recipe {recipe} did not do what it should. {why}
plug_updated_not: {plugin} was not updated, and stays at {from}.
plug_restored: {version} was put back and is running.
plug_restored_stopped: {version} was put back, and is not running.
plug_install_prose: Name where the plugin comes from: its name in the catalogue, a directory on this machine or the plugin.toml inside it, or a git repository with the branch, tag or commit after its last @. Reading it changes nothing.
plug_offer_prose: Everything this would do, as lemonfiber read it. Saying yes agrees to this reading, named {offer}, and lemonfiber refuses if anything has moved since.
plug_recipes_none: It declares no recipe, so it carries nothing anywhere.
plug_approved_count: {approved} of the {asked} values it would carry elsewhere are approved. A value left unapproved is not sent.
